verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS payments platform that handles business and customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI-training data use, opt-out controls, or data-usage policies. The cited items cover payments, onboarding, payouts, webhooks, the MCP server and the CLI, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
